anomalies.observed: On the top sheet (PCB.kicad_sch) the four bottom-edge pins of U2 are labelled VSS, VREF-, VREF+ and VSSA, and all four stubs are joined by a single horizontal wire that terminates in the GND symbol. Thus the VREF+ reference pin is tied directly to GND, while VDDA (pin 47) is tied to VCC.
anomalies.expected: Standard practice for the STM32L476 (and the spec's instruction to judge silent pins by good practice) requires VREF+ to be driven from the same rail as VDDA (VCC), with only VSS/VREF-/VSSA on GND. Tying VREF+ to GND contradicts this.

evidence.quote: Top sheet, U2 bottom edge: VSS / VREF- / VREF+ / VSSA stubs all merge into one wire ending at the GND symbol (PCB.kicad_sch)
The specification is silent on VREF+/VREF-; it directs that 'Where it is silent, judge the design with standard electrical-engineering practice.'

anomalies.impact: The ADC/touch-sensing positive reference is forced to 0 V, so any analog measurement referenced to VREF+ is invalid; it also creates an unintended low-impedance path on the analog reference pin.
